checks_explained: Small examples check formulas, exclusions, ordering and ties against expected results.
MovieLens database rows match the original source mapping; inference matches the notebook.
Adding community likes does not change MovieLens results.
Community metadata excludes the MovieLens catalogue account and reference time.
Browser results match API responses for search and feed; both collections use the same server.
Draft preview trims text and rejects blank input without saving a post.

preservation.earlier_databases: Verified backup outside the repository; content and relations retained in the unified database

limit: Checks demonstrate calculation and integration correctness. They do not establish recommendation quality on real social posts.
